description: The selectable demo scenarios (DEMO-09): scenario ids of the yantra-radios scenario folder (data/scenarios of the submodule), the items of the simulator's Scenario setting. The screenshot script, the user manual and the tests use the same ids.

scenarios.title: Indoor, good DAS coverage
scenarios.shows: A two-floor office with a DAS on each floor: strong indoor levels, the acceptance criteria pass.

scenarios.title: Indoor, weak DAS coverage
scenarios.shows: The same office with the DAS turned down: levels fall below the criteria away from the antennas.

scenarios.title: Serving-cell change between floors
scenarios.shows: A walk from the ground floor up to the first floor: the serving cell changes with the floor.

scenarios.title: Network with a failed site
scenarios.shows: A site announced in the neighbour lists but off the air, and one that drops out for 2 s.

scenarios.title: Weak signal, high noise
scenarios.shows: One weak cell near sensitivity with a noisy receiver and fading: decoding is marginal.
